content.title: 1 Mid-Cap Stock to Own for Decades and 2 We Question
content.summary: Mid-cap stocks have the best odds of scaling into $100 billion corporations thanks to their tested business models and large addressable markets. But the many opportunities in front of them attract significant competition, spanning from industry behemoths with seemingly infinite resources to small, nimble players with chips on their shoulders.

content.title: American Bitcoin pops on debut, Adidas & Wynn Resorts upgraded
content.description:
Josh Lipton and Prairie Operating Co. executive vice president of market strategy and TheBigSkinny.com founder Lou Basenese examine what's driving interest in some of the trending tickers during Wednesday's session. The pair discuss American Bitcoin's (ABTC) debut on the Nasdaq Composite (^IXIC), Jefferies analysts' bullish call on Adidas (ADDYY), and Argus upgrading Wynn Resorts (WYNN).

To watch more expert insights and analysis on the latest market action, check out more Market Domination.
